answer: Divergent-Challenge Fingerprinting: each identity must answer a random challenge derived from its own history, signed under a ferrous-hardware key. Clones share one root secret, so answers arrive in lockstep; a correct response must follow an unpredictable spiral of prior states that only independently-run agents can trace. Honest agents diverge naturally, riding each interaction tide differently. Enforcement: matching response sequences across identities trigger slashing.
